description: This file defines an Android Fragment subclass called FragmentArgumentsFragment, which demonstrates fragment configuration via Bundle arguments and layout attributes. It manages child fragments and inflates its layout from an XML resource.

classes.name: FragmentArgumentsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that demonstrates configuring nested fragments through arguments and layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles initial creation of the fragment, setting up child fragments if it's the first creation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from the specified XML.
